properties.name: url
properties.description: the URL of the XML document containing the error

properties.name: srcText
properties.description: the data where the error occurred

properties.name: line
properties.description: the line number in the XML document where the error occurred

properties.name: linepos
properties.description: the character position in the line containing the error

properties.name: filepos
properties.description: the absolute file position in the XML document containing the error
